top20.title: Virtual Seal
top20.desc: Another small Atari retro-style game for mobile.
top20.descZh: 另一款面向移动端的小型雅达利复古风格游戏。

top20.title: Far Wilds
top20.desc: A massive open-world survival adventure in an endless world.
top20.descZh: 一款在无尽世界中展开的大型开放世界生存冒险游戏。

top20.title: Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts
top20.desc: Classic puzzle logic game: unscrew bolts from all kinds of shapes and sort them by color into the correct containers. Every level is a new challenge requiring patience, logic, and careful planning.
top20.descZh: 经典解谜逻辑游戏，把各种形状上的螺栓拧下来，按颜色分类放进正确的容器。每关都是新挑战，需要耐心、逻辑和周密规划才能通关。

top20.title: My Beautiful Son
top20.desc: Gather food for your newborn son in a dangerous forest.
top20.descZh: 在危险的森林里为你新出生的儿子收集食物。

top20.title: Prism Breaker
top20.desc: Guide light to the gate in this monochrome world.
top20.descZh: 在这个单色世界中引导光线抵达大门。

top20.title: Gary's Scary Adventures
top20.desc: Help Gary solve puzzles with keyboard and mouse.
top20.descZh: 用键盘和鼠标帮助加里解开谜题。

top20.title: The Ritual of Nick Senny
top20.desc: Battle the "Nick Enemies".
top20.descZh: 与「尼克敌人」战斗。

top20.title: Spider Solitaire
top20.desc: The timeless card puzzle where strategy and precision win. Clear the board by stacking cards in descending order from K to A in the same suit.
top20.descZh: 经久不衰的纸牌解谜游戏，策略与精准方能取胜。按同花色从 K 到 A 降序排列卡牌，清空牌面。

top20.title: Waha's Horror Cleaning Service
top20.desc: It's just a small cleaning job, what could go wrong?
top20.descZh: 这只是份小小的清洁工作，能出什么问题呢？

top20.title: 8 Ball Pool: Billiards Multiplayer
top20.desc: Competitive billiards with thrilling duels: challenge friends or players worldwide, and sharpen strategy and skill against tough bots.
top20.descZh: 竞技体育台球游戏，在刺激的双人对战中与朋友切磋，或与全球玩家一较高下。与高手机器人对战，磨练你的策略与技巧。

top20.title: Real War (Not Fake)
top20.desc: Action shooter: lead your army across a scrolling battlefield, defend the front line, pick the right gates, accumulate rewards and troops, and survive to the end.
top20.descZh: 动作射击游戏，率领军队沿滚动的战场前进，在前线随时准备防御。选择合适的门通过，积累奖励和兵力，一路活着冲到最后。

top20.title: Times Ten
top20.desc: Collect and battle strange, scary monsters in this RPG roguelike!
top20.descZh: 在这款 RPG Roguelike 中收集并战斗奇异可怕的怪物！

top20.title: Polytrack
top20.desc: A classic racing game with a twist: drive the car you tuned yourself on tracks you may have designed yourself.
top20.descZh: 经典赛车游戏，但略有新意：驾驶你亲手改装的车，在或许由你自己设计的赛道上飞驰。

top20.title: Bid Boss
top20.desc: Be the ultimate auction boss! Inspect storage units with a flashlight, bid against shrewd rivals, and discover junk, treasures, or priceless jackpots.
top20.descZh: 成为终极拍卖老板！用手电筒检查储物单元，与精明的对手竞价，发现里面藏着什么：垃圾、珍宝，还是无价的头奖。

top20.title: Mini Golf Club
top20.desc: Multiplayer mini golf on short themed courses against real players. Sink the ball in as few strokes as possible before time runs out.
top20.descZh: 多人迷你高尔夫游戏，在简短的主题球场上与真实玩家同场竞技。目标是在计时结束前用最少的杆数把球入洞。

top20.title: Claw Master
top20.desc: A unique arcade RPG blending claw machines, roguelike mechanics, and dungeon crawling. Control the claw, collect loot, find powerful weapons, and uncover hidden treasures in dangerous dungeons full of monsters and epic bosses.
top20.descZh: 独特的街机 RPG，把抓娃娃机、Roguelike 机制和地下城探索融为一体。操控抓爪、收集战利品、发现强力武器、揭开隐藏宝藏，探索遍布怪物和史诗 Boss 的危险地下城。

top20.title: Sky Riders
top20.desc: A high-speed casual driving game. Complete several challenging tracks and test your driving skills.
top20.descZh: 高速休闲驾驶游戏。完成数条富有挑战性的赛道，测试你的驾驶技巧。

top20.title: WorldGuessr
top20.desc: A free GeoGuessr alternative: a casual quiz that tests and expands geography knowledge through immersive street-view exploration. Each round drops you at a random spot worldwide—infer your exact location from environmental clues.
top20.descZh: 休闲问答游戏，是 Geoguessr 的免费替代品，通过沉浸式街景探索来测试和扩展地理知识。每轮你都会被投放到全球随机地点，只能靠环境线索推断自己的确切位置。

top20.title: RocketGoal.io
top20.desc: An IO sports game: drive cars in fierce soccer showdowns. Race rocket-powered cars across the pitch, pull wild aerial stunts, and score as many goals as you can!
top20.descZh: IO 体育游戏，你驾驶汽车在足球场上与其他玩家展开激烈对决。开着火箭驱动的赛车驰骋球场，秀出狂野的空中特技，当然，还要尽可能多地进球！

top20.title: Lumber Harvest: Tree Cutting Game
top20.desc: A relaxing idle game: drive a powerful tractor to clear forests and collect timber. Upgrade your chainsaw, expand the truck, unlock new areas, and turn trees into profit.
top20.descZh: 轻松的养成游戏，驾驶强力拖拉机清理森林、收集木材。升级电锯、扩容卡车、解锁新区域，把树木变成利润。
